title: Nourishing Cheesy Australian Fish Bake
description: A delicious and festive Australian dish featuring fish sauce and cheese, perfect for a flexitarian-friendly dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together fish sauce, butter, lemon juice, and garlic.
Place the cod fillets in a copper pot and brush the fish sauce mixture evenly over both fillets.
Sprinkle the shredded cheddar cheese and grated parmesan cheese over the cod fillets.
Bake the fish in the preheated oven for 12 minutes or until it is cooked through and the cheese is melted and golden brown.
Remove the copper pot from the oven and sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top of the cheese.
Return the copper pot to the oven and bake for an additional 2 minutes or until the parsley is slightly wilted.
Remove the copper pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
